dch_fryer.text: Fish supper? It's Killybegs fish, came in this morning. Battered, salted, vinegared, and wrapped in paper, the way God and the Italians intended.
Half the chippers in Ireland were started by Italian families, you know. A fact I tell everybody, whether they've asked or not.

dch_customer.text: Curry chips. With a fork. Don't look at me like that.
